decision: Require a scored continuation before splitting a merged origin
evidence: Existing regression has a formatting-only blank continuation; rowspan alone does not prove a parent-child group

decision: Index parent linkage only from the mapped dimension column

decision: Use DOTALL (?s) flag for CATEGORY_TITLE_PATTERN in DeterministicScoreFactExtractor

consequence: Accurately identifies category title across newlines and prevents continuation row title weight fallback hijacking category score

decision: Retain title weight fallback for genuine leaf items while blocking parent categories
evidence: Disabling title weight fallback globally broke Project 1381 where score is embedded in leaf dimension titles
consequence: Protects against fix-A-break-B regressions across different table layout archetypes
